name: The Thing in the Tavern
description:
- A dried-out corpse to look at; moves like a trained killer.
- **Critical Damage**: drains blood (d6 STR damage).
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Creeping Ivy
description:
*Hedera sinister.*

- Looks like a thick, vivid covering of ivy.
- **Critical Damage**: paralyses its victim and drags them down the well.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Porcelain Soldier
description:
- Stand sentry on the Porcelain Wall, smooth white porcelain faces patched with moss and lichen.
- Attack only those who cross the battlements.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Forest Goblin
description:
- Superstitious in general, and of the statue's power in particular.
- Usually found mid-revel: drinking and competing.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Cursed Oak
description:
- Once a venerable titan of the forest, now a dark shape in the swamp.
- Vulnerable to fire: the wood is dead, kept moving by unnatural life.
- Deaf, but senses everything except the slightest movement.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes

name: Shadow-Possessed Dryad
description:
- As the Cursed Oak, but 8 HP and able to move.
- Screams in pain without a voice.
source: Seven Silver Spheres by Martin Orchard (pointlessmonument.itch.io); condensed Warden notes
